The present application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No. 41 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 3/4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Rights of Marriage) Act, Police Station Ganj, District Rampur.

2. At the outset, Ms. Rooma Singh, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present bail application with liberty to the applicant to file regular bail application before the Court of competent Syed Ziaul Hasan vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178813801/
1 jurisdiction.

sentences.text:
In view of the above, this application is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to the applicant to surrender before the concerned court and file regular bail application, which shall be decided in the light of decision rendered in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another,
Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No (s) 5191 of 2021 decided on 07.10.2021.
4.
